crossRefs.note: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear…
“You also came down on Mount Sinai, and spoke with them from heaven, and gave them right ordinances and true laws, good…
Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was…
But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.
For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it…
For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,
